notes.title: Development Status Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30885246/f0e8da7b3a538adfa0943f6479e8ca540c6629e8.png[/img]

[h3][i]We equally sad and delighted to bring you this news.
But fear not, the story doesn't end here.[/i][/h3]

[h2]TL;DR[/h2]
I’m Brian, the developer of the video game Ultraball. Today I am sharing news that is both exciting and scary in a number of ways. If you are reading this, that means that Ultraball’s development is currently halted so that I have the time to work on a new project.

My new game, based on hockey, is called Dizzy Danglers. This new game will be a collaborative effort of those of you in the community and anyone else looking to learn about game development.

For Ultraball veterans I want to say, from the bottom of my heart, thank you for coming with me on this journey. There were so many late nights and early mornings working on this project, and I hope it showed while you were playing. I am in great debt to all of you for helping me get the game to where it is today and I hope you can come along for this new journey as well.

If you would like to learn more about this new project and get involved in our community Discord server you can check out this link [url=https://discord.dizzydanglers.com]here[/url]. If you want to take a look at our source code so far, you can check it out [url=https://gitlab.com/BrokenGameplayStudios/DizzyDanglers/dizzydanglers-source]here[/url], or website [url=https://dizzydanglers.com/]here[/url].

If you want to know why?
... [url=https://www.ultraballgame.com/index.php/development-on-hold/]Read the full article[/url]

notes.title: Join the BETA!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/930441383232259726/E59DCEF3B9281697D86D3B5FF2BEFA4C9B246EA4/[/img]

Robojocks! Broken Gameplay Studios is proud to announce we are taking sign-ups for our upcoming BETA test. By signing up to the news letter you are giving us the ability to assign you a Key and have it mailed to you when the event begins!

We really appreciate your patience and excitement. 

Navigate to: http://www.brokengameplay.com and sign-up and confirm to our newsletter.

Thank you!
